name: Antigravity CLI
description: Runs Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) as a subscription-backed model provider.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Use an existing Antigravity CLI (agy) login on this host. Run `agy models` to confirm.

command.label: agy binary
command.help: Path to the agy executable. Prefer an absolute path after install; default `agy` resolves via PATH.

mode.label: agy mode
mode.help: Value for `agy --mode`, or `none` to omit the flag.

skipPermissions.label: Skip permissions
skipPermissions.help: Passes --dangerously-skip-permissions to agy. Off by default. Only enable if you accept tool runs without agy permission prompts.

maxConcurrency.label: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.help: Max simultaneous agy turns across all conversations/subagents.

liveSession.label: Warm live sessions
liveSession.help: Keep a warm agy process per conversation (faster follow-ups).

idleTimeoutSeconds.label: Idle timeout (s)
idleTimeoutSeconds.help: Evict an idle warm agy process after this many seconds.

maxSilentThinkingSeconds.label: Max silent keepalive (s)
maxSilentThinkingSeconds.help: Max time synthetic keepalives are emitted while agy is silent (keeps the OpenClaw session watchdog from firing).

mcpTimeoutSeconds.label: MCP timeout (s)
mcpTimeoutSeconds.help: timeoutSeconds written for MCP servers handed to agy.

command.description: Path to the agy binary. Defaults to `agy` on PATH. Prefer an absolute path; do not pass shell metacharacters.

mode.description: agy --mode value, or "none" to omit the flag.

maxConcurrency.description: Max simultaneous agy turns across all conversations/subagents.

liveSession.description: Keep a warm agy process per conversation (faster follow-ups).

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Idle warm agy process eviction timeout in seconds.

maxSilentThinkingSeconds.description: Max time synthetic keepalives are emitted while agy is silent.

mcpTimeoutSeconds.description: timeoutSeconds written for MCP servers handed to agy.
